rows.Name: IncidentsAllFields
Contacts
rows.QueryDefinition:
let
    DisplayNames = {},
    dbo_contract = Value.NativeQuery(
        CommonDataService.Database("psop.crm4.dynamics.com"),
        "
        SELECT DISTINCT contact0.*
        FROM Contact AS contact0
        WHERE
            contact0.statecode = 0 AND
            contact0.pdw_internal = 1 AND
            (contact0.emailaddress1 NOT LIKE N'%onmicrosoft%' OR contact0.emailaddress1 IS NULL) AND
            (contact0.emailaddress1 NOT LIKE N'%admin%' OR contact0.emailaddress1 IS NULL)
        ",
        null,
        [EnableFolding = true, DisplayNames = DisplayNames]
    )
in
    dbo_contract

rows.Name: Calendar
rows.QueryDefinition:
ADDCOLUMNS(
    CALENDAR(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2030, 12, 31)),
    "Jahr", YEAR([Date]),
    "MonatNr", MONTH([Date]),
    "Monat", FORMAT([Date], "MMMM"),
    "JahrMonat", FORMAT([Date], "YYYY-MM"),
    "Quartal", "Q" & FORMAT(QUARTER([Date]), "0"),
    "JahrQuartal", FORMAT([Date], "YYYY") & "-Q" & FORMAT(QUARTER([Date]), "0")
)
